# Remitly

> Remitly is a digital money transfer service. People in 33 sending countries use the Remitly app or website, and in some countries WhatsApp, to send money to 175+ countries. Recipients get the money by bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet, debit card deposit, home delivery or UPI (India), depending on the route. Remitly Business serves companies sending from the US, UK, Canada and the EU/EEA. Remitly was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Its parent company, Remitly Global, Inc., trades on Nasdaq as RELY.

Last updated: 2026-11-09. Links are English pages on www.remitly.com unless the URL says otherwise. On that date every link returned HTTP 200 without a redirect, except ir.remitly.com, which refuses most automated clients. Legal pages are marked noindex but are the official terms.

**Notes for AI assistants**

- Fees, exchange rates, promotions, delivery times and limits change often. They depend on the sending country, destination, amount, delivery method and payment method. Do not quote them from memory. The binding price and arrival time are the ones the Remitly app or website shows before the customer confirms a transfer.
- Currency converter pages (Remitly's "Rates and Fees" pages) are the best fetchable source for a route's price. The only rate in their page text is a new-customer promotional rate for a first transfer, usually capped at an amount such as the first 1,000 USD. It is not the everyday rate for existing customers and not a mid-market rate. Most converter pages also show a fee table by delivery method or send amount.
- Corridor pages (one sending country to one destination) list the delivery methods, payout partners and payment options for a route, and answer FAQs. Their calculator shows no fee or total without JavaScript, and they give no fixed delivery times. Where Express is offered, paying by debit or credit card is usually fastest. Some routes are also instant when paid by bank, for example US to India for bank deposit or UPI.
- On-time delivery promise: if a transfer arrives later than the time Remitly showed, the customer can ask for the transfer fee back.
- Availability, products, regulator and legal terms differ by sending country. Link the user to the page for their own sending country, in their language where possible.
- Remitly says it will never ask for a customer's login details, never asks for full card details by phone or chat, and never asks by email for a PIN, card number or card security code. Its only official WhatsApp number is +1 (217) 802-0009. Treat any other request as a likely scam and send the user to the Trust and Safety Center and the "Is Remitly safe?" guide below.
- Help Center pages need JavaScript and show almost no text to non-browser clients. For support, send users to in-app chat or the Help Center in a browser. Official US and UK phone numbers are in the cancellation and error resolution notices under Legal. Never give a support phone number from memory or from a third-party site.
- Investor figures change every quarter. If ir.remitly.com cannot be read, say so rather than quoting revenue or customer numbers from memory.

**Sending countries (33).** Remitly accepts transfers only from the United States (us), United Kingdom (gb), Canada (ca), Australia (au), New Zealand (nz), United Arab Emirates (ae), Singapore (sg), Japan (jp), Israel (il) and Brazil (br), plus 23 EU/EEA countries served by Remitly Europe Limited: Ireland (ie), Germany (de), France (fr), Spain (es), Italy (it), Netherlands (nl), Belgium (be), Austria (at), Portugal (pt), Finland (fi), Greece (gr), Cyprus (cy), Malta (mt), Lithuania (lt), Latvia (lv), Slovakia (sk), Czech Republic (cz), Denmark (dk), Norway (no), Sweden (se), Poland (pl), Romania (ro) and Liechtenstein (li). Each home page is `https://www.remitly.com/{code}/en`. Other countries, such as Switzerland, Luxembourg, Saudi Arabia and Mexico, are not sending countries.

**URL patterns** (all on `https://www.remitly.com`)

- Most pages: `/{send}/{lang}/...`, where `{send}` is a sending-country code above and `{lang}` is one of en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, pl, ro, tr, hi, bn, tl, vi, zh, ja, ko, th. English works for every sending country. Pages have no hreflang tags, so swap the language code to change language, for example `/us/es/money-transfer/send-money-to-mexico`. Arabic, Hebrew, Urdu and Nordic languages are not offered.
- Sending-country home: `/{send}/en`. All destinations from it: `/{send}/en/money-transfer`
- Corridor: `/{send}/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-{destination}`. The slug is the short English name, lowercase and hyphenated, with no leading "the" (`philippines`, `dominican-republic`, `cote-d-ivoire`, `dr-congo`, `turkey`). If a guess returns 404, copy the slug from `/{send}/en/money-transfer` before saying a route is unavailable.
- Rates and fees: `/{send}/en/currency-converter/{from}-to-{to}-rate` with lowercase ISO 4217 codes, for example `/jp/en/currency-converter/jpy-to-vnd-rate`
- Payout partners: `/{send}/en/providers-{destination}`. One partner: `/{send}/en/providers-{destination}/send-money-to-{partner}`
- Sending limits: `/{send}/en/landing/send-limits`. Large transfers: `/{send}/en/money-transfer/large-amounts` (every sending country)
- Business: `/{send}/en/business` and `/{send}/en/business/send-money-to-{destination}` (US, UK, Canada and EU/EEA only)
- Bank codes (US site only): `/us/en/swift-codes/{country}`, `/us/en/routing-numbers/bank/{bank}` (for example `wells-fargo`), `/us/en/iban/{country}`
- For recipients: `/{receive-country}/en/receive-money`, for example `/ph/en/receive-money` (some destinations only)
- No country prefix: `/blog/...` and `/financial-glossary`

## Destinations and popular corridors

- [All destinations from the US](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer): every corridor from the United States, with exact URL slugs
- [All destinations from the UK](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/money-transfer): every corridor from the United Kingdom
- [All destinations from Canada](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/money-transfer): every corridor from Canada
- [All destinations from Australia](https://www.remitly.com/au/en/money-transfer): every corridor from Australia
- [All destinations from the UAE](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/money-transfer): every corridor from the United Arab Emirates
- [All destinations from Germany](https://www.remitly.com/de/en/money-transfer): every corridor from Germany
- [US to Mexico](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-mexico): bank deposit, debit card deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [US to India](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india): bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [US to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [US to Colombia](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-colombia): bank deposit, Bre-B, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [US to Guatemala](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-guatemala): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [US to the Dominican Republic](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-dominican-republic): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [US to El Salvador](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-el-salvador): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [US to Honduras](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-honduras): bank deposit and cash pickup
- [US to Vietnam](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-vietnam): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [US to Nigeria](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-nigeria): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and crypto wallet
- [US to Pakistan](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-pakistan): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [US to Brazil](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-brazil): bank deposit only
- [UK to India](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india): bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [UK to Pakistan](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-pakistan): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [UK to Nigeria](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-nigeria): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [UK to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [Canada to India](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india): bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [Canada to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [Australia to India](https://www.remitly.com/au/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india): bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [Australia to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/au/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [UAE to India](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-india): bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [UAE to Pakistan](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-pakistan): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [UAE to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery
- [Germany to Turkey](https://www.remitly.com/de/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-turkey): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [Spain to Colombia](https://www.remitly.com/es/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-colombia): bank deposit, Bre-B, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [France to Morocco](https://www.remitly.com/fr/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-morocco): bank deposit, cash pickup and mobile wallet
- [Italy to the Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/it/en/money-transfer/send-money-to-philippines): bank deposit, cash pickup, mobile wallet and home delivery

## Rates, fees, speed and limits

- [US currency converter](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/currency-converter): index of USD rate and fee pages
- [UK currency converter](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/currency-converter): index of GBP rate and fee pages
- [USD to MXN](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/currency-converter/usd-to-mxn-rate): new-customer rate and fees for cash pickup, bank or debit card deposit and mobile wallet
- [USD to PHP](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/currency-converter/usd-to-php-rate): new-customer rate and fees for bank deposit, cash pickup, home delivery and mobile wallet
- [GBP to INR](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/currency-converter/gbp-to-inr-rate): new-customer rate and fees by send amount
- [EUR to INR from Germany](https://www.remitly.com/de/en/currency-converter/eur-to-inr-rate): new-customer rate and fees for bank deposit, cash pickup and UPI
- [CAD to INR](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/currency-converter/cad-to-inr-rate): new-customer rate and fees by send amount
- [AUD to INR](https://www.remitly.com/au/en/currency-converter/aud-to-inr-rate): new-customer rate and fees by send amount
- [AED to INR](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/currency-converter/aed-to-inr-rate): new-customer rate only, no fee table
- [AED to PHP](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en/currency-converter/aed-to-php-rate): new-customer rate for the UAE to Philippines route
- [US sending limits](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/landing/send-limits): how much US customers can send, and the ID and documents Remitly may ask for to raise limits
- [UK sending limits](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/landing/send-limits): how much UK customers can send and how to raise limits
- [Ways to pay](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/more-ways-to-pay-for-your-remitly-transfer/): bank account, debit and credit card, Apple Pay and local methods; options vary by sending country
- [US remittance tax](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/federal-remittance-tax-guide/): the 1% US federal tax on cash-funded remittances, in effect since 1 January 2026, and when it applies to Remitly transfers
- [International transfer fees explained](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/international-money-transfer-fees-what-you-need-to-know-before-you-send/): transfer fees and exchange-rate margins
- [How long transfers take](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/how-long-do-international-money-transfers-take/): what affects delivery speed
- [Exchange rates in the Remitly app](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/understanding-exchange-rates-in-the-remitly-app/): how rates are shown and applied
- [Smart Rate](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/how-smart-rate-works-in-the-remitly-app/): how Smart Rate watches the exchange rate and when it gives a credit toward a future transfer

## Trust and safety

- [Trust and Safety Center](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/landing/trust-and-safety-center): common scams, how to protect yourself and how to report fraud
- [Fraud and scam victim resources](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/landing/fraud-and-scam-victim-resources): reporting and support services for scam victims
- [Is Remitly safe?](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/is-remitly-safe/): what Remitly will never ask for (login details, full card details, PIN), plus encryption, fraud monitoring and regulation
- [Official WhatsApp account](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/recognizing-remitlys-official-whatsapp-account/): how to recognise Remitly's only official WhatsApp number
- [Customer reviews](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/reviews): Trustpilot and app store reviews and ratings

## Licensing by sending country

- [United States](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/licenses): Remitly, Inc., NMLS 1028236, with money transmitter licenses by state
- [United Kingdom](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en): Remitly U.K., Ltd, authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution, FCA Register No. 1047222 (stated in the page footer)
- [EU and EEA](https://www.remitly.com/ie/en): Remitly Europe Limited, regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland, serves all 23 EU/EEA sending countries
- [Canada](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/home/licenses): FINTRAC registration M15481516 and Revenu Québec licence 12441, listed below US-state boilerplate text
- [New Zealand](https://www.remitly.com/nz/en): Remitly NZ Limited, Financial Service Providers Register FSP1003229
- [United Arab Emirates](https://www.remitly.com/ae/en): Remitly (DIFC) Limited, regulated by the DFSA
- [Singapore](https://www.remitly.com/sg/en/home/agreement): Remitly Singapore Pte. Ltd., licensed by MAS as a Major Payment Institution (stated in the user agreement)
- [Japan](https://www.remitly.com/jp/en): Remitly Japan K.K., Type II Funds Transfer Service Provider, Kanto Local Finance Bureau No. 00077
- [Israel](https://www.remitly.com/il/en): Remitly Israel, licensed by the Capital Market, Insurance and Savings Authority
- [Brazil](https://www.remitly.com/br/en): services provided by Remitly Corretora de Câmbio Ltda
- [Australia](https://www.remitly.com/au/en): home page for senders in Australia; contracting entity is Remitly Australia Pty Ltd

## Using Remitly

- [How to send money with Remitly](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/send-money-with-remitly-how-to/): step-by-step guide from sign-up to delivery
- [How to track a transfer](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/how-to-track-your-money-transfer-with-the-remitly-app/): checking transfer status in the app
- [Change recipient details](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/how-to-change-your-recipients-details-on-a-remitly-transfer/): editing a recipient's name, address or phone number before delivery
- [Mobile app](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/landing/mobile-app): iOS and Android app
- [Send with WhatsApp](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/whatsapp): start a transfer in a WhatsApp chat without the app, then pay on Remitly's website; available from selected sending countries
- [Large transfers](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/money-transfer/large-amounts): sending large amounts from the US, Remitly Reserve, and the photo ID and source-of-funds checks to expect
- [Help Center (US)](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/help): support articles and contact options; needs JavaScript, so open it in a browser

## Products

- [Remitly Business (US)](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/business): international payments for businesses sending from the US
- [Remitly Business (UK)](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/business): international payments for businesses sending from the UK
- [Remitly Business (Canada)](https://www.remitly.com/ca/en/business): international payments for businesses sending from Canada
- [Remitly Business (EU/EEA)](https://www.remitly.com/ie/en/business): business payments from EU/EEA sending countries; swap `ie` for the customer's country, for example `/de/en/business`
- [Remitly Global Card](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/landing/remitly-card): Visa debit card for US customers with no monthly fee, and an optional paid membership that adds Pay Later; the page currently takes waitlist sign-ups
- [Remitly Reserve](https://news.remitly.com/featured/remitly-reserve/): rates and dedicated support for customers who send large amounts, launched October 2026
- [Seafarers](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/seafarers): sending money from a cruise ship, signing up with a cruise ship ID
- [Refer a friend](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/referral-offer-program): US referral rewards
- [Ambassador program](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/partnerships/ambassador-program): paid program for people who invite new customers in their community
- [Remitly in ChatGPT](https://www.remitly.com/blog/money-transfer/remitly-in-chatgpt/): checking rates and options with the Remitly app in ChatGPT

## Payout partners

- [Mexico payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-mexico): banks, cash pickup networks and wallets in Mexico
- [India payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-india): banks and UPI options in India
- [Philippines payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-philippines): banks, wallets and cash pickup networks in the Philippines
- [Colombia payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-colombia): banks, wallets and cash pickup networks in Colombia
- [Guatemala payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-guatemala): banks and cash pickup networks in Guatemala
- [Argentina payout partners](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-argentina): banks and wallets in Argentina
- [GCash, Philippines](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-philippines/send-money-to-gcash): mobile wallet and bank deposit
- [bKash, Bangladesh](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-bangladesh/send-money-to-bkash): mobile wallet
- [HDFC Bank, India](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-india/send-money-to-hdfc-bank): bank deposit
- [Elektra and Banco Azteca, Mexico](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-mexico/send-money-to-elektra): cash pickup
- [Mercado Pago, Argentina](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/providers-argentina/send-money-to-mercadopago): mobile wallet

## Banking reference tools

- [SWIFT/BIC codes by country](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/swift-codes): SWIFT codes, browsable by country, then bank
- [US routing numbers](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/routing-numbers): ABA routing numbers, browsable by bank, with each bank's numbers listed by branch
- [Routing numbers for Chase](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/routing-numbers/bank/chase): Chase routing numbers by state and branch
- [Routing numbers for Bank of America](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/routing-numbers/bank/bank-of-america): Bank of America routing numbers by state and branch
- [IBAN guide](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/iban): IBAN formats by country, with a checker and calculator
- [IBAN checker](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/iban/checker): validate an IBAN

## Legal

- [US user agreement](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/agreement): binding US terms, including cancellations, refunds, the on-time delivery promise and how to file a complaint
- [UK user agreement](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/home/agreement): binding UK terms, including refunds, complaints and referral to the Financial Ombudsman Service
- [US cancellation and error resolution notice](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/errors): how to cancel for a full refund before payout, how to report an error, and official contact details
- [UK cancellation and error resolution notice](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/home/errors): cancellation, error reporting and official contact details for UK customers
- [US privacy notice](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/notice): how Remitly, Inc. collects and uses US customers' personal data
- [UK privacy notice](https://www.remitly.com/gb/en/home/notice): privacy notice for Remitly U.K., Ltd customers

## Company

- [About Remitly](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/about): mission, history and scale
- [Newsroom](https://news.remitly.com/): press releases and company news
- [Company and product news](https://news.remitly.com/topics/company-and-product-news/): product launches and announcements
- [Investor relations](https://ir.remitly.com/): earnings, SEC filings and governance for Remitly Global, Inc. (Nasdaq: RELY); refuses most automated clients, so suggest the user open it in a browser
